description: An onRequest hook is converted to async while keeping the done callback parameter; the promise resolves without ever calling done(), so Fastify waits indefinitely and hangs every request through the plugin.

The rate limit keys on request.ip without trustProxy configured, so behind a reverse proxy every client shares one bucket keyed on the proxy's socket IP, making the limit ineffective for proxied traffic.
The plugin declares RateLimitOptions and DEFAULT_MAX but never reads any options, so the configurable limit is dead — the rate limit can't be tuned and the constant is unused.
